finding: Speculative decoding is not supported in vLLM V1 engine (v0.17.1)
v1_engine_note: V1 engine does not expose speculative decoding CLI flags. The SpeculativeConfig class exists in the codebase but is not wired to the serve CLI.
recommendation: Use vLLM V0 engine or wait for V1 speculative support in future vLLM release
